description: An object of numbers selected beside a map of strings becomes a map of strings
notes: The spec says map and object types unify by preferring the object type, so the selected object would stay an object holding the number 1. hashicorp/hcl unifies the object's attribute types as a map, a map of numbers, unifies that with the map of strings to a map of strings, and converts the object to it (unifyObjectsAsMaps in cty/convert/unify.go), so the result is a map holding the string "1".
